pakistan_salary.rule: Aim for PKR 100,000/month or more. Because the user urgently needs work, consider suitable legitimate offers from PKR 60,000-70,000 upward, with PKR 70,000 preferred as the practical minimum. If an employer publishes a lower salary range, negotiate toward the top of its range and do not demand an unrealistic amount that would prevent an urgent opportunity. Never enter an expectation below PKR 60,000. If no salary is published, state PKR 100,000/month. If a range is published, use its upper end or a modest amount above it where realistic, while keeping the user's urgent-job flexibility.

international_salary.rule: Use the employer's published salary range and currency. If a range is published, target a reasonable amount near or modestly above its upper end when the form allows negotiation. If no salary is published, enter Negotiable / market-competitive where text is accepted; do not invent a numeric amount or convert currencies without a reliable posted range. Leave mandatory numeric salary fields for manual review.

work_authorization.rule: For Pakistan jobs, answer Yes to legal authorization to work. For jobs in other countries, answer No to current work authorization and Yes to requiring employer visa/work-permit sponsorship.

employment_types.conditional: Internship, contract, or temporary roles are acceptable when there is a credible path or possibility of conversion to permanent full-time employment.

medical_privacy.rule: Do not disclose hearing loss or infer limitations. If a required medical/disability/accommodation question cannot be skipped or answered truthfully without further user instruction, mark for manual review. Never use it to automatically reject an otherwise suitable role.
